summary: The market is holding its afternoon gains, with the Nifty near Monday's close, as firmer European markets add support. Beneath the surface, several mid and small caps are still hitting fresh lows.

detail.leaders: IT, PSU banks, Oil & Gas, Chemicals; ICICI Bank, TCS, Reliance
detail.laggards: Hospitals and healthcare; NSDL, Max Financial at 52-week lows; BSE
detail.tone: Steady versus 13:30. The last firm print was 1 pm (Nifty 22,790.95, +0.33%; Sensex 72,989.48, +0.63%), and afternoon reports say the benchmarks are holding their gains.
